answer: Make every identity post a bond before it can earn: a stake locked in escrow, like a boat tied to a jetty, that only returns after honest work. Any peer can challenge suspicious behaviour with evidence; if the challenge holds, the bond is slashed and shared with the challengers. A lone ember of honest effort keeps its stake and grows; a farm of fakes must lock a bond for every single identity, and each one risks being burned like a comet that flares once and dies. The cost of a thousand fakes is a thousand bonds, while the reward per fake stays flat.
